reserves.name: Locked GLD NFTs representing physical gold bars in Swiss vaults
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Gold DAO GLD NFT swap canister over Bity Tokenisation SA gold certificates for physical bars held at Loomis Schweiz AG, Kloten

reserveReview.reviewer: PoR verification sweep 2026-08 (lockstep coherent refresh: report and composition review updated together from the same artefact)

sources.label: Gold DAO audit reports (KPMG SA Neuchatel)

reserveReview.rationale: Pinned to the newest verifiable artefact: KPMG SA Neuchatel Swiss AS 920 report of factual findings, procedures on site 21 September 2025, signed 2 October 2025 (PDF read this pass; expressly 'we do not express any assurance'): 790 Loomis GLD gold certificates representing 7.9kg of 1kg bars at Loomis Schweiz AG, supplier invoices covering 7.8992kg, 100 of 790 serials physically re-verified. The report reconciles gold to GLD NFT certificates of Bity Tokenisation SA, not to GLDT token supply. The live gldt.org page still shows current gold figures (reviewed 2026-07-30) but is not an attested artefact; the series is ~10.5 months stale.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG SA report of factual findings as of 21 September 2025
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The backing class is identified as locked GLD NFTs representing physical gold, but bar inventory beyond the 2025-09-30 KPMG factual-findings count, serial-level allocation, and per-bar custody shares are not disclosed in the reviewed sources.

sources.label: Gold DAO KPMG vault audit reports

custodyProfile.uncertainty: GLD NFTs map to specific physical gold bars with serial-level certificates, and the 2025-09 KPMG factual-findings report names Loomis Schweiz AG, Kloten as the vault operator holding 7.9 kg of gold for 790 certificates issued by Bity Tokenisation SA, supporting bar-level segregation; KPMG frames the reports as agreed-upon procedures rather than an assurance audit, and no report after 2025-09-30 is published as of 2026-07-30. The reviewed sources do not establish insolvency treatment or rehypothecation terms.
